note: Emergency and assistance numbers for Masinloc, supplied by the project. This file is the single source of truth: scripts/build-help-desk.py renders help-desk.html from it and scripts/check-help-desk.py refuses any number on the page that is not declared here. Correct a number here, never in the HTML.
rules: This site is an independent community platform and is not the municipal government. These numbers are published so a resident can reach the office directly — nothing routes through this website, and no message sent through Masinloc Connect reaches any of these offices.

Every number here is a published emergency or assistance contact for an office or an elected barangay official acting in that role. No private residential number, and no number belonging to a private individual in a personal capacity, belongs on this page.

A number that can no longer be verified is removed rather than left to sit. An emergency number that rings nowhere is worse than an absent one, because somebody will dial it instead of a number that works.

tel: links are the point of this page — on a phone, one tap is the difference between calling and copying digits under pressure. scripts/check-help-desk.py keeps tel: links confined to this page so the site-wide no-phone rule stays intact everywhere else.

Numbers are stored exactly as they are dialled, grouped in threes and fours the way they are written and read locally. The tel: href is derived from the digits, so the printed form stays human and the link stays machine-correct.
